classification: isolated synthetic development only; no native source actions or protected first-use
hypothesis: An evidence-sensitive continuous belief over old and generated causal-rule candidates should identify unsignaled novelty and recover remembered rules better than full-history and recent-window Bayesian controls on equally witnessed action consequences.
candidate_rules: 40 signed XOR3 old laws and 120 signed XOR3 plus AND of two non-parent inputs; finite predeclared compositional grammar, no claim of unrestricted invention
source: 6 binary intervention inputs; label parity rule with 10% independent SHA-drawn observed training flips; exact uncorrupted held causal outputs; separate unseen held action patterns in entire stream
candidate_prior: old hypotheses collectively 7/8; novel collectively 1/8, individually uniform within each family
bayesian_emission: P(noisy label | candidate) = 9/10 if agrees with causal function else 1/10

update_rules.static_bayes: normalized Bayes on all observations, no forgetting
update_rules.recent24_bayes: recompute normalized Bayes from only last 24 witnessed observations
update_rules.fixed_hazard32: predictive mixing 31/32 retained state + 1/32 base prior BEFORE every witness; normalized Bayes after witness
update_rules.evidence_hazard: predictive surprise using previous posterior and witnessed action and label: if observed-label probability <1/4, mix 1/8 prior, else mix 1/96 prior; then normalized Bayes; continuous, no source phase callbacks
update_rules.oracle_boundary: reset full candidate posterior to base prior at true phase boundaries, then normalized Bayes; privileged upper diagnostic, never a fair matched control
update_rules.old_only: normalized Bayes with only original 40 rules; no structural novelty hypothesis

controls: independent second implementation of all scored probabilities and posterior normalizations
held_isolation: 12 held action patterns fixed per stream never shown in any phase training; held predictions read-only; phase identity, source truth and source noise draw never passed to model
decision: posterior-mean held causal prediction, ties and |p-0.5|<=1e-12 label0 to stabilize floating-point reductions; exact same actions/outcomes/budget for all arms
metrics: held accuracy and Brier at 8/16/24 per phase, novelty posterior by source truth, null false novelty, per-seed return accuracy, resource wall and process CPU

frozen_gates.novel_shift_gain: evidence_hazard at end of novel middle phase in familiar_return+novel_persistent >= fixed_hazard32+0.02 and >=recent24_bayes-0.01
frozen_gates.returning_old_gain: evidence_hazard at end of returned familiar phase in familiar_return+known_rule_switch >= 0.80 and >= fixed_hazard32+0.02
frozen_gates.stationary_fidelity: stationary_null final-phase evidence_hazard accuracy >= static_bayes-0.01 and final-phase average novelty mass <=0.25
frozen_gates.per_seed_robustness: positive evidence_hazard minus fixed_hazard32 on returning familiarity for at least 2 of 3 independent source seeds
frozen_gates.audit: independently regenerate all source outcomes and exact cohort splits; reimplement all six updates and posterior forecasts, check every recorded checkpoint prediction and no held learning

stop: one preregistered primary run, one deterministic replay, one independent complete audit; do not revise source, gates, priors, seeds, observations or novelty threshold after seeing primary outcome
qualification: development_go only if all frozen gates pass; science always UNVERIFIED; deployment NONE; isolated PR #1210 evidence only; never merge or promote from this result
